head.title: Passion Meets

profile.name: MD Rasel Hasan
profile.bio: Passionate about building AI-powered applications, modern web platforms and scalable backend systems.

intro.title: Who I Am
intro.body: I'm a Computer Science student and Full Stack Developer who enjoys creating meaningful software solutions. My interests include Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, scalable backend systems, and modern frontend development. I continuously learn new technologies, improve my problem-solving skills, and enjoy turning complex ideas into elegant products.

journey.title: From Curiosity To
journey.body: Every year introduced a new challenge, a new technology, and a new opportunity to grow as a developer.
journey.timelineBody: A short account of the steps that shaped the way I build software.

start.title: Started Programming
start.text: Began my software development journey by learning HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Focused on building responsive interfaces and understanding modern frontend development.

fullstack.title: Transition to Full Stack
fullstack.text: Expanded into backend development, databases and authentication. Started building complete web applications from frontend to deployment.

university.title: University Projects
university.text: Focused on academic software development, backend architecture, authentication, CRUD systems, and real-world university projects.

product.title: Product Development
product.text: Started building complete digital products, improved system architecture, UI/UX, cloud media management and scalable web platforms.

ai.title: AI & Research
ai.text: Shifted focus toward Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, research, and AI-powered software solutions. Presented an AI disaster intelligence research project.

next.title: What's Next?
next.text: Building AI products, contributing to open source, freelancing globally, publishing research, and creating impactful software used by thousands of people.
